message: the other session is putting to much effort into language and human review thing. I think the app should be way simpler. No need for human interaction. I provide the electoral plans myself from trusted sources. The only thing about languages are potential translations. The website have the quiz or the comparison tool. We collect relevant metrics like if people agrees or not and what topics do people most agree on (annonimized). Review the whole plan and strongly change it and cut it to the real important app. but still the devil is in details. But this is not a backoffice but a users service and remmber its free and we dont need a big infra
